triggerReason: After a successful initial load, a later Observatory refresh failure retained the last snapshot without telling the human observer that the live read path had failed. Release review also found that a direct source-directory bind was not portable across Docker user namespaces and could expose ignored host files to evaluated code.
action: Keep the last successful snapshot for continuity, but surface a bilingual assertive stale-data warning with the last successful browser refresh time and bounded endpoint failure reason. Add a mobile fault-injection scenario covering retained data, English and Chinese copy, WCAG A/AA and horizontal containment. Freeze only Git-trackable source plus installed dependencies into a mode-0444 archive before starting the networkless, read-only evaluator, then remove the archive after evaluation.
outcome: The targeted and complete production-build browser suites pass. Full local acceptance covers 259 non-PostgreSQL tests, 16 real PostgreSQL/restore tests, all deterministic gates, 28 browser/axe scenarios and 10,000-tick stability. The pinned Node 24 evaluator passes lint, 259 tests, model regression and build with no network, a read-only root, dropped capabilities and a read-only frozen source archive. Remote acceptance remains required before Tag or deployment.
